title: Identification of cancer stem cell-related genes through single cells and machine learning for predicting prostate cancer prognosis and immunotherapy
summary: Single-cell analysis and random-forest prioritization identified HSPE1; four external datasets and 60 prostate specimens support a specific prognostic marker result. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: Affiliated Tumor Hospital of Nantong University; The First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University

evidence.tested: Single-cell analysis and random-forest prioritization identified HSPE1; four external datasets and 60 prostate specimens support a specific prognostic marker result.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: The paper uses single-cell clustering and random forest to prioritize stem-cell genes, then tests a multigene diagnostic model in four separate datasets.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
